children: Singapore's manufacturing growth is likely to moderate in 2027 from this year's strong momentum, CGS International economists say in a note. Industrial production growth accelerated in October, driven by strong performance in the precision engineering segment. Ongoing artificial intelligence infrastructure investment and semiconductor demand should support electronics production, they note. However, the potential moderation in next year's factory output would reflect a normalization in global electronics demand and a higher base, they say. CGS International projects Singapore's manufacturing growth to cool to 7.0% in 2027 from its 2026 forecast of 10.0%.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
